errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a visible label. The description fabricates a label based on external context (the caption), which is not part of the figure itself.

The description of the y-axis range is inaccurate. While the highest tick mark is 0.012, the data for the MEMIT line clearly extends above this value to approximately 0.0125, so the data range is not limited to 0.012.
The color of the MEMIT line is more accurately described as light blue or cyan, not simply blue.
The final value for the AlphaEdit line at x=3000 is approximately 0.001, not 0.0015. The value 0.0015 corresponds to the data point at x=1500.

errors.text_span: as the number of edits increases from 0 to 3000
errors.evidence: The data does not start at an x-value of 0. The first data point for both lines is at an x-value greater than 0, approximately 250.
The MEMIT line starts at a y-value of approximately 0.0045, which is visibly below 0.005.
The final value for the MEMIT line at x=3000 is visibly above the 0.012 grid line, at approximately 0.0125. Stating the value is 0.012 is an underestimate.
